Baa Ram Ewe Lanolin Skin Balm 120g 

Discover the timeless wonder of our Lanolin balm. 

Formulated with Pure lanolin, this rich, protective balm soothes and hydrates even the driest , most delicate skin. 

Its luxurious texture melts effortlessly providing a soothing layer of moisture that lasts all day. 

Perfect for hands, elbows, knees, lips, or any area in need of extra care, it forms a protective barrier that locks in moisture leaving skin feeling smooth & rejuvenated. 

Treat your skin to the nourishing luxury it deserves, with the enduring benefits of this multi-purpose balm. 

INGREDIENTS: 

Lanolin Anhydrous,Pure Australian Lanolin, Vitellaria Paradora,Organic Shea Butter, Cera Alba, Bees Wax, Retinolds, Vitamin A , Tocoherol, Viamin E 

DAILY RITUAL: 

Soften balm between hands and apply daily. 
Proudly Made In South Australia 
Cruelty Free 

No Artificial flavouring, parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates.

Its silky smooth texture glides on effortlessly, forming a protective barrier that locks in moisture and restores your lips natural softness. 

Treat your lips to the nourishment they deserve. 

Lanolin used in all our products is humanely sourced from Australian sheep farmers.

seed_data.title: Baa Ram Ewe Lanolin Skin Balm 50g UNSCENTED
seed_data.description:
Discover the timeless wonder of our Lanolin Skin Balm. 

Formulated with pure lanolin, this rich, protective balm soothes and hydrates even the driest , most delicate skin. 

Its luxurious texture melts effortlessly providing a soothing layer of moisture that lasts all day. 

Perfect for hands, elbows, knees, lips, or any area in need of extra care, it forms a protective barrier that locks in moisture leaving skin feeling smooth & rejuvenated. 

Treat your skin to the nourishing luxury it deserves, with the enduring benefits of this multi-purpose balm. 

INGREDIENTS: 

Lanolin Anhydrous,Pure Australian Lanolin, Vitellaria Paradora,Organic Shea Butter, Cera Alba, Bees Wax, Retinoids, Vitamin A , Tocoherol, Viamin E 

DAILY RITUAL: 

Soften balm between hands and apply daily. 
Proudly Made In South Australia 
Cruelty Free 

Humanely Sourced & Cruelty Free 

No Artificial flavouring, parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates.

seed_data.title: Lucamar Baalm 50g  UNSCENTED
seed_data.description:
Uncover the classic power of our Skin Baalm, a refined blend of lanolin and hemp seed oil, designed to care for skin, hands, beards and tattoo's. 

This luxurious balm draws from time-honoured grooming traditions, deeply moisturising and restoring with every use. Lanolin's rich emollient properties work to soften & protect, while the nourishing essence of hemp seed oil helps to rejuvenate and maintain healthy skin. 

Whether soothing dry, cracked hands, taming facial hair, or enhancing the vibrancy of your tattoo, this balm delivers the care your body deserves. 

A timeless companion for the modern man, embracing the strength and elegance of old-world craftsmanship with every application. 

INGREDIENTS: 

Pure Australian Anhydrous Lanolin, Humanely Sourced Vitellaria paradoxa. Organic Shea Butter , Australian Hemp extract. Cera Alba, Australian Bees Wax, Vitamin A, E, Frankincense & Ginger Body Safe fragrance 

No parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates. 

DAILY RITUAL: 

Soften balm between hands and apply on the required areas. Only a little is needed as it goes a long way . 

Proudly Made In South Australia 

Cruelty Free

seed_data.title: Ugly Bird Emu Oil 30mls 100% Pure
seed_data.description:
Pure Ugly Bird Emu Oil. 

We have bottled this miracle oil with a hint of Frankincense oil for all to enjoy the amazing benefits of Emu Oil. 

A precious, natural elixir revered for centuries for its soothing and restorative properties. Derived from the Emu bird, this luxurious oil penetrates deeply into the skin. 

Rich in essential fatty acids and antioxidants,Emu oil helps reduce the appearance of fine lines & wrinkles by improving skin elasticity, enhances overall texture of the skin. 

Studies have shown that Emu Oil penetrates all layers of the skin, providing rich nutrients that helps stimulate skin cell regeneration. 

Because of the amazing anti-inflammatory properties, it assists in reducing swelling and a number of skin conditions. 

Tattoo After Care 

This amazing oil creates a natural moisturising barrier to help prevent the skin from excessive drying and flaking, and yet still allows the skin to breathe during the healing process. Studies have shown Emu oil penetrates all layers of the skin, providing rich nutrients that help the skin aid in new cell development.
